overview.text: 四 means “four.” Its current form encloses inner 儿-form strokes within 囗. Its origin is disputed: it may be a direct numeral graph or a borrowed graph; neither proposed borrowing account is established.

components.text: 囗 forms the enclosing outer shape in the present graph.
儿 identifies the inner strokes in the present graph; their ancient role is unresolved.
